about: The operations of the LetzCloud node. The generator (tools/generate-operations.mjs) reads this file and the OpenAPI document named in 'openapi', checks every name here against that document, and writes 'output'. A field, path or parameter this file names that the document lacks fails the generator. 'handWritten' lists the routes the credential, the trigger and the wait operations call, with the fields that code reads or sends.

booleanCopy.disabled: Whether the DNS record is disabled
booleanCopy.dynamic_scaling_enabled: Whether CPU and memory can be changed while the instance runs
booleanCopy.enable_csi: Whether to install the CSI driver for persistent volumes
booleanCopy.expunge: Whether to remove the instance at once instead of keeping it recoverable for a while
booleanCopy.external_load_balancer: Whether to use an external load balancer for the control plane

descriptions.ContainerCreate.container_image: Image to run, such as nginx:latest, up to 512 characters

descriptions.ContainerCreate.custom_cpu_millicores: CPU limit in millicores, from 100 to 32000, used only when Container Size is 'custom'
descriptions.ContainerCreate.custom_memory_mb: Memory limit in MB, from 64 to 65536, used only when Container Size is 'custom'
descriptions.ContainerCreate.health_check_path: HTTP path LetzCloud calls to check that the container is healthy; /health when left empty

descriptions.ContainerCreate.max_replicas: Largest number of copies of the container that run, from 1 to 100
descriptions.ContainerCreate.min_replicas: Smallest number of copies of the container that run, from 0 to 100
descriptions.ContainerCreate.name: Name of the container, up to 128 characters
descriptions.ContainerCreate.port: Port the container listens on, from 1 to 65535; 8080 when left empty

descriptions.ContainerCreate.registry_url: Address of the container registry, for an image on your own registry

descriptions.DatabaseClusterCreate.l3_customer_id: ID of the customer who will own the database. A provider key must set it.
descriptions.DatabaseClusterCreate.memory_gb_per_node: Memory per node in GB, from 1 to 512; replaces the tier's default

descriptions.DatabaseClusterCreate.read_replicas: Number of read replicas, from 0 to 10

operations.name: Change State
operations.description: Start, stop or reboot an instance. LetzCloud answers at once with a job; use Wait for State to wait until the instance has the new state.

operations.name: Create
operations.description: Create an instance. LetzCloud answers at once with a job; the instance appears in Get Many while it is created.

exclude.host_id: placement on a named host is for cloud administrators

operations.name: Delete
operations.description: Delete an instance. Its root disk goes with it; with Expunge it cannot be recovered.

operations.name: Get
operations.description: Get an instance by ID

operations.name: Get Many
operations.description: Get many instances

operations.name: Wait for State
operations.description: Wait until an instance is running or stopped, reading it again at an interval until a time limit

operations.name: Create
operations.description: Create a volume, and attach it to an instance if one is named

operations.name: Delete
operations.description: Delete a volume. The data on it is lost.

operations.name: Get
operations.description: Get a volume by ID

operations.name: Get Many
operations.description: Get many volumes

operations.name: Create
operations.description: Create a snapshot of a volume

operations.name: Delete
operations.description: Delete a volume snapshot. The volume cannot be restored from it afterwards.

operations.name: Get Many
operations.description: Get many volume snapshots

operations.name: Create
operations.description: Create a network

operations.name: Delete
operations.description: Delete a network. Instances can no longer connect to it.

operations.name: Get
operations.description: Get a network by ID

operations.name: Get Many
operations.description: Get many networks

operations.name: Create
operations.description: Create a Kubernetes cluster. LetzCloud answers at once with a job; pass its job ID to Wait Until Running to wait for the cluster.

exclude.master_nodes: deprecated; Control Plane Nodes replaces it

operations.name: Delete
operations.description: Delete a Kubernetes cluster. Its nodes and the workloads on them are removed.

operations.name: Get
operations.description: Get a Kubernetes cluster by ID

operations.name: Get Many
operations.description: Get many Kubernetes clusters

operations.name: Wait Until Running
operations.action: Wait until kubernetes cluster is running
operations.description: Wait until the cluster a Create made is running: reads the create job for the cluster ID, then the cluster, until a time limit

operations.name: Create
operations.description: Create a container from an image

operations.name: Delete
operations.description: Delete a container. It stops serving and its replicas are removed.

operations.name: Get
operations.description: Get a container by ID

operations.name: Get Many
operations.description: Get many containers

operations.name: Create

operations.name: Delete

operations.name: Get

operations.name: Get Many

operations.name: Get Many
